alt: Table declaring the CPS ASEC 2025 release: universe, weights, 160 replicate weights with 159 degrees of freedom, pooling, series breaks, known traps, and the date each item was verified.
note: Provenance: design.json = machine-readable manifest field; design.json notes = the manifest's free text; producer = documentation read 2026-09-10; computed = counted from the store by build.py; book guidance = editorial, not a producer rule.

rows.value: CPS ASEC 2025, IPUMS CPS (YEAR = 2025); income and last-year coverage items refer to calendar year 2024
142,125 person records with a positive ASECWT
Noninstitutionalized persons in the 50 states and DC who are civilian adults (15 and older) or live with one; Armed Forces members living with their families are included, those in barracks are not
Includes the CHIP expansion sample (about 10,000 extra eligible housing units, part of the CPS since July 2001) to improve state estimates of children's coverage
ASECWT; person weight; household-level tabs use ASECWTH on PERNUM=1
Replicate: successive difference replication method (for cases in self-representing strata) and the modified half-sample technique (for cases in non-self-representing strata)
REPWTP1–REPWTP160 (person) and REPWT1–REPWT160 (household), in the companion file cps/cps_asec_repwt joined on YEAR, SERIAL, PERNUM
(4/160) × Σ_r (θ_r − θ̂)², deviations taken from the full-sample estimate
159 (160 replicates - 1, per IPUMS CPS repwt FAQ); replicate weights cover 2005+ only
Not applicable: no PSUs are declared
Not recorded. To pool k ASEC years, divide ASECWT and every replicate weight by k before estimating totals (means and shares are unchanged)

2014 income redesign and 2019 processing change are series breaks. Variable availability differs by decade part (see availability matrix). A 2020-Census-based CPS sample began phasing in with April 2025 and completes in July 2026 (BLS expects a negligible effect on estimates)

rows.source: design.json; computed from data; producer: IPUMS CPS repwt FAQ
rows.value: legitimate; for variance estimation only (use iweight-style handling); 132 negative replicate values among the 2025 person records. Stata declares iweights for this reason
Verified on the 2025 file: the default call reports a Taylor SE with df = 141,910 (n − 1); the replicate call reports df = 159
YEAR is the survey year; income, poverty, and last-year coverage describe the previous calendar year
Replicate block verified 2026-07-11 against https://cps.ipums.org/cps/repwt.shtml; FAQ re-read 2026-09-10

source: IPUMS CPS repwt FAQ (https://cps.ipums.org/cps/repwt.shtml); Census ASEC documentation (https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/sahie/technical-documentation/model-input-data/cpsasec.html); BLS CPS sample redesign (https://www.bls.gov/cps/methods/sample_redesign_2025.htm)
